bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'STK04_CREATE_RUNTIME_BEGIN\n'
printf 'SOURCE_HEAD=';git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'TARGET_SOURCE_DIR=';pwd
printf 'CREATOR_RELATED_CONTAINERS\n'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Image}}' | grep -Ei 'videobot|create|gaybbs|postgres' | head -n 20 || true
printf 'CREATOR_EXISTING_COMPOSE\n'
find deploy -maxdepth 2 -iname '*compose*' -type f -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -n 12 || true
printf 'CREATOR_AUTH_CONFIG\n'
if test -f /home/gace/.config/create-videobot/bot_token; then echo CREATOR_SECRET_FILE_PRESENT;else echo CREATOR_SECRET_FILE_MISSING;fi
printf 'CREATOR_SERVER_DIR\n'
find /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler -maxdepth 3 -iname '*videobot*' -type d -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -n 10 || true
echo STK04_CREATE_RUNTIME_END
